syntheticSetup.clockDerivation: For each day, Tmin 20 C and Tmax 30 C are above Tbase 10 C and below Tupper 32.2 C. Under the frozen single-sine method, mean temperature 25 C yields exactly 15 C-days. The source thermal clock starts at each per-cell plantedAt date/event; v3 physiology GDD starts at each per-cell establishedAtDate.
